# MDL509 · `table-group-not-dumped`

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs from internal/rules: do not edit. -->

A table section names a table the `regex` of [mydumper] excludes.

| | |
|---|---|
| Family | tables |
| Default severity | info |
| Fix | — |
| Flags | opt-in |

## Why

mydumper dumps only the tables whose `db.table` matches `regex`. A table section for another table is dead: often a leftover of a copied file, or a sign the regex is wrong. In a load set, the regex of the extra file wins over the defaults file's. Opt-in, because the regex is often set on the command line instead.

## Example

❌ Before:

```ini
[`app`.`orders`]
where=1
```

```text
1:2-1:16 info MDL509[table-group-not-dumped] app.orders does not match the regex ^app\.users$ (from defaults.cnf): mydumper never dumps it
  = The settings of this section never apply.
```

## Configuration

Opt-in: enable it with `--extend-select MDL509`, or in `.mydumper-lint.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  extend-select: [MDL509]
```

To accept one occurrence, put `# mydumper-lint: disable-next-line=MDL509` on the line above it.
